eyebrow: SQL Server Database Administration · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 19 · Database Creation & Configuration

steps.label: AUTO_CREATE_STATISTICS
steps.sub: fills in missing stats on the fly

steps.label: AUTO_UPDATE_STATISTICS
steps.sub: refreshes stale stats, both default ON

code:
-- Large, high-concurrency OLTP table:
-- avoid the synchronous stats-update pause
ALTER DATABASE Sales
  SET AUTO_UPDATE_STATISTICS_ASYNC ON;
caption: Trades a briefly stale statistic for a smoother latency profile.
